atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(50, "Coil Lookback", 10, 120, 1)
volVolLookback = input(20, "Vol-of-Vol Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
predictLookback = input(20, "Predictability Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
coilThreshold = input(80, "Coil Threshold", 50, 95, 1)
predictThreshold = input(55, "Predict Threshold", 20, 90, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Multiple", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rangeNow = high - low
maxAtr = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
minAtr = lowest(atrVal, coilLookback)
atrSpan = max(maxAtr - minAtr, 0.000000001)
coilAtr = (maxAtr - atrVal) / atrSpan
maxRng = highest(rangeNow, coilLookback)
minRng = lowest(rangeNow, coilLookback)
rngSpan = max(maxRng - minRng, 0.000000001)
coilRng = (maxRng - rangeNow) / rngSpan
atrPrev = atrVal[1]
atrChg = (atrVal - atrPrev) / max(atrPrev, 0.000000001)
volOfVol = stdev(atrChg, volVolLookback)
vvMax = highest(volOfVol, coilLookback)
vvMin = lowest(volOfVol, coilLookback)
vvSpan = max(vvMax - vvMin, 0.000000001)
volRank = (volOfVol - vvMin) / vvSpan
coilLoad = 100 * (0.5 * coilAtr + 0.3 * coilRng + 0.2 * volRank)
chg = change(close)
absChg = abs(chg)
denP = max(absChg, 0.000000001)
posBit = max(chg, 0.0) / denP
negBit = max(0.0 - chg, 0.0) / denP
dirNow = posBit - negBit
var dirAvg = 0.0
dirAvg := (dirAvg * (predictLookback - 1) + dirNow) / max(predictLookback, 1)
predictVal = 100 * abs(dirAvg)
expandRatio = rangeNow / max(atrVal, 0.000000001)
expandTrig = rangeNow > releaseMult * minRng
loaded = coilLoad > coilThreshold
predOk = predictVal > predictThreshold
loadedUnpred = loaded and not predOk
loadedPred = loaded and predOk
buyRaw = loadedPred and expandTrig and close > open
sellRaw = loadedPred and expandTrig and close < open
alertRaw = loadedUnpred and expandTrig
buySig = buyRaw and not buyRaw[1]
sellSig = sellRaw and not sellRaw[1]
alertSig = alertRaw and not alertRaw[1]

if buyFire {

varip f1Hist = array(0)
varip f2Hist = array(0)
varip f3Hist = array(0)
varip closeHist = array(0)

ccPct = (close - close[1]) / (close[1] + 0.000000001) * 100
hlPct = (high - low) / (close + 0.000000001) * 100
coPct = (close - open) / (open + 0.000000001) * 100

meanCC = sma(ccPct, featLen)
meanHL = sma(hlPct, featLen)
meanCO = sma(coPct, featLen)

maxCC = highest(abs(ccPct), featLen) + 0.000000001
maxHL = highest(abs(hlPct), featLen) + 0.000000001
maxCO = highest(abs(coPct), featLen) + 0.000000001

f1Cur = meanCC / maxCC
f2Cur = meanHL / maxHL
f3Cur = meanCO / maxCO

array.push(f1Hist, f1Cur)
array.push(f2Hist, f2Cur)
array.push(f3Hist, f3Cur)
array.push(closeHist, close)

numBars = array.size(f1Hist)
searchStart = numBars - 1 - trainWin
if searchStart < 0 { searchStart := 0 }
searchEnd = numBars - 1

bestD0 = 999999.0
bestD1 = 999999.0
bestD2 = 999999.0
bestD3 = 999999.0
bestD4 = 999999.0
bestD5 = 999999.0
bestD6 = 999999.0
bestL0 = 0
bestL1 = 0
bestL2 = 0
bestL3 = 0
bestL4 = 0
bestL5 = 0
bestL6 = 0

j = searchStart
while j < searchEnd {
    df1 = f1Cur - f1Hist[j]
    df2 = f2Cur - f2Hist[j]
    df3 = f3Cur - f3Hist[j]
    dist = sqrt(df1 * df1 + df2 * df2 + df3 * df3)
    lbl = 0 - 1
    if closeHist[j + 1] > closeHist[j] { lbl := 1 }
    if dist < bestD0 {
        bestD6 := bestD5
        bestL6 := bestL5
        bestD5 := bestD4
        bestL5 := bestL4
        bestD4 := bestD3
        bestL4 := bestL3
        bestD3 := bestD2
        bestL3 := bestL2
        bestD2 := bestD1
        bestL2 := bestL1
        bestD1 := bestD0
        bestL1 := bestL0
        bestD0 := dist
        bestL0 := lbl
    } else {
        if dist < bestD1 {
            bestD6 := bestD5
            bestL6 := bestL5
            bestD5 := bestD4
            bestL5 := bestL4
            bestD4 := bestD3
            bestL4 := bestL3
            bestD3 := bestD2
            bestL3 := bestL2
            bestD2 := bestD1
            bestL2 := bestL1
            bestD1 := dist
            bestL1 := lbl
        } else {
            if dist < bestD2 {
                bestD6 := bestD5
                bestL6 := bestL5
                bestD5 := bestD4
                bestL5 := bestL4
                bestD4 := bestD3
                bestL4 := bestL3
                bestD3 := bestD2
                bestL3 := bestL2
                bestD2 := dist
                bestL2 := lbl
            } else {
                if dist < bestD3 {
                    bestD6 := bestD5
                    bestL6 := bestL5
                    bestD5 := bestD4
                    bestL5 := bestL4
                    bestD4 := bestD3
                    bestL4 := bestL3
                    bestD3 := dist
                    bestL3 := lbl
                } else {
                    if dist < bestD4 {
                        bestD6 := bestD5
                        bestL6 := bestL5
                        bestD5 := bestD4
                        bestL5 := bestL4
                        bestD4 := dist
                        bestL4 := lbl
                    } else {
                        if dist < bestD5 {
                            bestD6 := bestD5
                            bestL6 := bestL5
                            bestD5 := dist
                            bestL5 := lbl
                        } else {
                            if dist < bestD6 {
                                bestD6 := dist
                                bestL6 := lbl
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    j := j + 1
}

sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]

hHighPrev2 = hHigh[1]
hLowPrev2 = hLow[1]

bearConf = hClose < hLowPrev and hHigh < hHighPrev

hRange = hHigh - hLow
hRangePrev = hHighPrev - hLowPrev
disp = abs(hClose - hClosePrev)

noWickBull = hClose > hHigh - hRange * 0.25
noWickBear = hClose < hLow + hRange * 0.25

bearScore = 50 + (dispBig ? 25 : 0) + (noWickBear ? 25 : 0)

results.code:
wx = input(1.0, "wind_direction_vector_x", -5, 5, 0.1)
wy = input(0.0, "wind_direction_vector_y", -5, 5, 0.1)
wz = input(0.0, "wind_direction_vector_z", -5, 5, 0.1)
wSpeedIn = input(10.0, "wind_speed_knots", 0, 100, 0.5)
maxSpd = input(50.0, "max_speed_knots", 1, 100, 1)
baseTail = input(1.0, "base_tail_length", 0.1, 5, 0.1)
lenPer = input(0.1, "length_per_knot", 0.01, 1, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = close - open
rng = high - low + 0.000001
gust = drift / rng
mom = close - close[1]
momN = mom / rng
effX = wx + gust + 0.25 * momN
effY = wy + 0.5 * gust + 0.15 * momN
effZ = wz + 0.5 * momN + 0.1 * gust
effSpeed = wSpeedIn + abs(drift) + 0.5 * abs(mom)
mag = sqrt(effX * effX + effY * effY + effZ * effZ)
magSafe = mag + 0.000001
nx = effX / magSafe
ny = effY / magSafe
nz = effZ / magSafe
horiz = sqrt(effX * effX + effY * effY)
horizSafe = horiz + 0.000001
yawRaw = atan2(effY, effX)
pitchRaw = atan2(effZ, horizSafe)
yawRad = mag > 0 ? yawRaw : 0
pitchRad = mag > 0 ? pitchRaw : 0
yawDeg = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchRaw * 57.29578
rollDeg = 0
tailLen = baseTail + (effSpeed * lenPer)
ratioRaw = effSpeed / (maxSpd + 0.000001)
ratioC = ratioRaw < 0 ? 0 : ratioRaw > 1 ? 1 : ratioRaw
colR = ratioC
colG = 0.5 * ratioC
colB = 1 - ratioC
windCol = ratioC > 0.66 ? "#ff8800" : ratioC > 0.33 ? "#cc6622" : "#2266ff"
originP = 0
tipP = 0 + tailLen
hiLine = 0.8 * maxSpd
loLine = 0.2 * maxSpd
yawPrev = yawDeg[1]
pitchPrev = pitchDeg[1]
yawChg = abs(yawDeg - yawPrev)
pitchChg = abs(pitchDeg - pitchPrev)
highSig = effSpeed > hiLine and effSpeed[1] <= hiLine
lowSig = effSpeed < loLine and effSpeed[1] >= loLine
shiftSig = yawChg > 30 or pitchChg > 30
shiftEvent = shiftSig and not shiftSig[1]
arrowEvent = highSig or lowSig or shiftEvent
buySig = lowSig
sellSig = highSig or shiftEvent
arrowBaseState = arrowEvent
arrowHeadState = arrowEvent
arrowBaseSig = arrowBaseState and not arrowBaseState[1]
arrowHeadSig = arrowHeadState and not arrowHeadState[1]

if highSig and not highSig[1] {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "triangledown", "#ff8800")
}
if lowSig and not lowSig[1] {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "LowWind", "triangleup", "#2266ff")
}
if shiftEvent {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Shift", "diamond", "#ff8800")
}

plot(effSpeed, "Wind Speed knots", "#ff8800", 2, "separate")
plot(tailLen, "Tail Length", "#2266ff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(effSpeed, "Wind Speed 3D", "trail", "#ff8800", "separate")
plot3d(tailLen, "Tail Length 3D", "mesh", "#2266ff", "separate", 1)
